name: TC-PTC-04: View All Comparison link does not reuse a product card's URL
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/PopularTruckComparison.cy.js#Homepage - PopularTruckComparison [hi] TC-PTC-04: View All Comparison link does not reuse a product card's URL
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-PTC-04
**Title:** View All Comparison link does not reuse a product card's URL
**Language:** hi

**Description:**
Confirm the View All Comparison link does not accidentally point at the first product card's PDP URL.

**Expected Result:**
View All Comparison and the first product card link to different URLs.

**Steps:**
1. Open Popular Truck Comparison
2. Verify View All's href differs from the first product's href
